component.name: YOLOv8n (pretrained)
component.description: Ultralytics YOLOv8 pretrained on COCO 2017. Not fine-tuned for SmartSight; recognises only its 80 COCO classes.

detector_model.name: YOLOv8n (pretrained)
detector_model.description: Ultralytics YOLOv8 pretrained on COCO 2017. Not fine-tuned for SmartSight; recognises only its 80 COCO classes.
detector_model.licence: AGPL-3.0 (Ultralytics); commercial use requires an Ultralytics Enterprise licence

component.name: yolo_world_door_sign
component.description: Pretrained open-vocabulary YOLOv8-World prompted with 'door' and 'exit sign' (not fine-tuned), verified by colour and shape rules.

component.name: embedding_matcher
component.description: ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV3-Small features (not fine-tuned) + colour histogram + ORB keypoints. Thresholds are uncalibrated defaults.

component.name: kmeans_lab
component.description: k-means clustering in CIELAB with CIEDE2000 nearest named colour.

component.name: rule_based_context
component.description: Deterministic geometric rules over detector output (baseline; not a trained model).

component.name: rule_based_intent
component.description: Keyword/regex rules with weighted scoring (baseline; not a trained model).

component.name: known_size_pinhole
component.description: Calibrated monocular distance from typical object sizes and camera field of view.
